style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, no drawn overlays
motion_rule: HE is the subject of every window and crosses the frame edge to edge in EVERY window, talking ones too, always SIDEWAYS, never toward or away from the lens; every move starts by shoving off glass, gravel or furniture; he never lies, hovers or talks still; the lens is INSIDE the water a claw from him, the glass wall is the frame edge, the tank never seen whole; HE fills two thirds of the frame height, legs in shot, nothing between him and the lens; a new tight shot size every window; the last frame still moves
character: a glossy red lobster in a black tailcoat, a monocle, ONE huge claw and one small
second_characters: TWO CRABS in bow ties, close past the lens
props: a blank cream price tag on a string behind him; a red velvet rope; a velvet stool
prop_continuity: the tag trails from his small claw to the last frame, never on his body; speech is heard, never shown
environment: inside a glass tank, water filling the frame, a rich salon with gilt frames and chandeliers blurred beyond the glass; gravel floor with a slope, a velvet stool; HE stays in the tank
lighting: bright chandelier light through the water

audio.language: Russian, verbatim, nothing added or repeated; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: deep chesty male voice, calm and unhurried, even 4.3 syllables per second
audio.pacing: speech 0.7-2.3 and 2.9-8.0; voiceless outside, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth and mandibles open on every syllable
audio.sfx: clinking beyond the glass, water surging, gravel scattering, claws on glass, a rope whipping

timeline.a: silent. THE LOBSTER slams the glass at the lens and rakes past left to right, gravel bursting, A CRAB spun aside
THE LOBSTER hits the far glass, kicks off it and tears back right to left
THE LOBSTER cartwheels claw over tail edge to edge across the gravel, A CRAB ducking under him
THE LOBSTER rams the stool, springs off it and slings himself along the gravel
THE LOBSTER flips onto his back and rakes the gravel with all legs, skidding left to right, head huge in the lens
still on his back THE LOBSTER whips his tail and shoots right to left, the tag streaming behind
THE LOBSTER kicks the glass, rolls upright and drives along the bottom, gravel spraying the lens
THE LOBSTER rams the slope and climbs it the whole frame height
THE LOBSTER launches off the slope and sails edge to edge over both CRABS
THE LOBSTER punches the gravel and rebounds bottom of frame to top
THE LOBSTER tears along the glass a claw from the lens, the tag snapping behind
THE LOBSTER kicks the glass, drives edge to edge, kicks the far wall and drives back
THE LOBSTER rams the stool and shoves it across the tank, A CRAB tumbling off
THE LOBSTER hurls himself up the glass bottom to top, gravel raining off him
THE LOBSTER lands astride the sliding stool and rides it edge to edge, big claw up, THE CRABS whipping the rope past the lens, all moving

must_appear: the tag trailing, gravel flying, both crabs, tailcoat and monocle, the rope at 10.0
negative_prompt: speech bubble, cyrillic, subtitles, watermark, night, dark scene, a still camera, a wide shot, the whole tank in frame, the table under the tank, a small hero, a hero lying still, a museum pose, a prop on his body, a frozen final frame, slow motion, any word after 8.0, silence in the tail
